fact: TechAfrica News reports Djibouti's National Assembly passed its first Digital Code in plenary, eight books and nearly 800 articles including Book VI on Cybersecurity and Cybercrime, with no mention of promulgation or entry into force; no event date given, so the published date of 2025-07-02 is used.
system: Digital Code (Code du numérique), Book VI Cybersecurity and Cybercrime

fact: Jones Day reports the National Assembly passed the Digital Code, covering cybersecurity and cybercrime and punishable online offences, on 30 June 2025, with the legislative section still to be promulgated by the President and published in the Journal Officiel.
source_slug: 2025-07-01 Djibouti Digital Code adopted by National Assembly

fact: The ratification law cites Law n°66/AN/14/7ème L of 20 July 2014 on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime as part of Djibouti's legal framework.
system: Loi n°66/AN/14/7ème L relative à la cyber sécurité et à la lutte contre la cybercriminalité
